# Rokoko Football Quarterback source motion

- File: `Football_Quarterback_mixamo.fbx`
- Publisher: Rokoko
- Pack: Rokoko mocap: 12 free sports animations
- Source page: https://www.rokoko.com/resources/rokoko-mocap-12-free-sports-animations
- Official download: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1lazpVXEa5Om8lEBmCUDGxueZdUgLnBr4
- Technical format: FBX, Mixamo skeleton, 30 FPS

The publisher's source page states that these free full-body sports animations may be used in animation, VFX, game, and 3D projects, including commercial projects.

This FBX is currently vendored for source-motion evaluation in the isolated 3D Player Lab. It is not integrated into normal gameplay. Production use should retarget and bake approved motion offline onto the canonical Gridiron Legends player skeleton, then export a clean GLB for Three.js.
